features: 50 W boAt Signature Sound: Experience augmented audio that elevates movie viewing to the next level with the boAt Aavante Bar A1040 Soundbar. 50 W boAt Signature Sound brings visuals to life with enthralling audio so you can enjoy edge-of-the-seat thrillers to the fullest.

2.1 Channel Soundbar with Subwoofer: Not just 2.1 channels, this soundbar also comes with a subwoofer that recreates the cinematic atmosphere of the theatre in your living space. Feel each sound element with high clarity for immersive viewing.

Multiple Connectivity Options: Sporting wireless Bluetooth v5.3 compatibility along with a host of ports, such as HDMI (ARC), AUX, and USB, this soundbar offers matchless convenience to dive into the audio realm.
High-Performance Drivers: Aavante Bar A1040 makes streaming and gaming captivating, thanks to the integrated drivers that deliver thumping audio.
EQ Modes: With dedicated EQ modes- Music, Movies, and News, this soundbar adapts the audio to the entertainment format so you can unwind at ease to the content of your choice.
description: Enjoy a cinematic experience at home with the power-packed audio of the boAt Aavante Bar A1040 Bluetooth Soundbar. 50 W boAt Signature Sound packs a punch to deliver heightened immersion into the content. Watch your comfort movies and disconnect from reality with the captivating sound. You can even enjoy adrenaline-raising gaming with your buddies as this 2.1-channel soundbar also boasts a subwoofer. With its exceptional design, this soundbar is bound to make a statement addition to your audio space. Moreover, you can connect Aavante Bar A1040 wirelessly using Bluetooth v5.3 or plug into any of the available ports, such as USB, AUX, and HDMI (ARC). Just settle into your comfortable viewing spot and grab the master remote to fine-tune the audio to your liking. Not just volume, bass, and treble, you can switch between News, Movies, and Music EQ modes too, for a better viewing experience.
